changelog:
- Major update: Migrated from Node.js SDK to Python HTTPS API scripts for all skill operations.
- Added unified Python-based API Key management script (api_key.py) with secure auto-discovery and creation.
- All skill operations now use secure API Key handling: keys are never hardcoded, printed, or directly accessed.
- Replaced previous Node.js scripts with Python scripts (list_indices.py, retrieve.py) and removed obsolete scripts.
- Introduced mandatory per-command User-Agent with session tracking for all CLI and HTTPS API calls.
- Updated documentation and workflow reflecting new Python-based usage, security, and auditability requirements.
summary: Alibaba Cloud Bailian Knowledge Base Retrieval Tool. Use HTTPS API to query and retrieve knowledge base content. Use when: User needs to query knowledge base...
